title: 15th Finance Commission Grant — Q4 Release
title_hindi: 15वें वित्त आयोग अनुदान — चौथी तिमाही जारी
content: The Government of Bihar, Panchayati Raj Department hereby notifies that the 4th installment of 15th Finance Commission grants for FY 2024-25 has been released to all eligible Gram Panchayats. Panchayats are directed to utilize funds within 60 days and submit utilization certificates.

title: Ward Sabha Mandatory — April 2025
content: All Gram Panchayats are directed to conduct Ward Sabha meetings between 14-30 April 2025. Agenda must include: review of ongoing projects, beneficiary selection for PMAY-G, and MGNREGS demand registration. Non-compliance will result in fund withholding.

title: Social Audit — May 2025 Schedule
content: Social audit of MGNREGS works will be conducted in all blocks during May 2025. Panchayat Sachivs must ensure all muster rolls, job cards, and payment records are available. District-wise schedule attached.

title: Training Completion Deadline — TRN-003
title_hindi: प्रशिक्षण पूर्णता की अंतिम तिथि — TRN-003
content: All Panchayat Sachivs who have not completed the Financial Management & Fund Utilization training (TRN-003) are directed to complete it by 30 April 2025. Non-completion will be noted in annual performance review.

title: eGramSwaraj Data Entry — March Deadline
title_hindi: ई-ग्राम स्वराज डेटा एंट्री — मार्च की समय सीमा
content: All Panchayats must complete data entry of Q3 expenditure on eGramSwaraj portal by 15 April 2025. Incomplete entries will affect grant release for Q1 FY 2025-26.
